details:
Note: This post is an attempted revision of my last one, where I tried to describe what I initially found as a bug for me on desktop. I am making this because I have tested this bug more thoroughly, and have found it to be far more impactful than I had originally thought. (If anyone could delete my previous bug report, which was done in-game, that'd be much appreciated.)

Description:

Ever since the release of the update that brought the new HUD UI for desktop players to the main branch, I've been experiencing this bug. The bug I'm experiencing is one that makes it so, whenever I'm holding down a button on my mouse -Left Mouse Button, Right Mouse Button, and Middle Mouse Wheel Button- the action of me holding that button is immediately released if I attempt to move my mouse at all. 

This bug affects in-world UI's, holdable items, VRChat's official UI itself, the VRChat camera, any and all kind of sliders that involve holding down the mouse and dragging them, and more. Whenever I attempt to hold one of my mouse buttons down to perform an action regarding these, VRChat immediately makes me let go upon moving the mouse itself. I have found no way as of yet to fix this, and for me at least, it affects everything in the game. I've been unable to manipulate volume on video-players, move the VRChat camera at all for the purpose of taking pictures and or prints, hold and look around with items in-world with them in hand -rendering some game worlds nearly impossible to play for me-, scroll down menus both in-world and with VRChat's official UI, and more.

As for how to reproduce this bug, I am not sure. All I can say is that I'm running VRChat through Proton on Linux Mint -I'll be happy to provide details on which versions both are, if requested- and playing only on desktop. This bug is always active for me, and I have been unsuccessful in finding a usable workaround and or fix for it.
title: Held mouse buttons release upon movement of the mouse on desktop
